caveats: The Jev estimate applies TypeSafe's published $42 per billion input-token rate. The cited page does not state an output-token price, so this catalog treats Jev output tokens as unbilled and requires invoice reconciliation.
The Bedrock estimate uses Standard-tier global Claude Sonnet 5.5 rates. Cache, batch, priority, reserved-capacity, and negotiated-price adjustments are excluded.
The Strands Decider estimate uses the us-east-2 Linux On-Demand g5.xlarge list price of $1.006 per hour. It excludes EBS, EKS control-plane, data-transfer, observability, and support charges.

SELF_HOSTED_ACTIVE_COMPUTE path cost allocates only measured Decider call latency and therefore represents a full-utilization floor. selfHostedCapacity separately reports the cost of keeping the node provisioned across the measured benchmark window and exposes observed utilization.
Provider estimates include successful calls captured by the harness. Failed calls without returned usage, taxes, network transfer, and shared application infrastructure are excluded.
The pilot corpus labels are draft; cost and latency are measurable, but safety-quality conclusions require independently approved labels.
